mapper.select: SELECT code,name,enabled,revision FROM nw_foundation_dictionaries WHERE owner_key=#{owner} ORDER BY code

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_dictionaries(owner_key,tenant_id,code,name,enabled,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{owner},CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),#{command.code},#{command.name},#{command.enabled},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_dictionaries SET name=#{command.name},enabled=#{command.enabled},revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by=#{actor} WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND code=#{command.code} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_dictionary_values(owner_key,tenant_id,dictionary_code,code,label,sort_order,enabled,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{owner},CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),#{command.dictionaryCode},#{command.code},#{command.label},#{command.sortOrder},#{command.enabled},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
